notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-21. Same part as POT-GAIN. The centre detent is honestly warranted here and not elsewhere: at centre the wiper sits at exactly 0V by topology (it spans +Vin/2 and -Vin/2), so the nonlinear branch carries no current and the stage is mathematically linear - unlike POT-OFFSET, whose detent review found lands ~20deg off its true zero | 2026-09-21, from the genuine Taiwan Alpha RV09 series datasheet now in the repo (datasheets/connectors/RV09AF-40.pdf). FOUR THINGS THE ORDER CODE HAS TO CARRY, none of which this row said. (1) THE PLAIN -40 HAS NO BUSHING AT ALL - it is snap-in, and the panel needs only shaft clearance. A bushing is a SUFFIX: E1 = metal M9x0.75, E1N = plastic D9, and either makes the panel hole ~9.5mm instead of a shaft hole. (2) CENTRE DETENT IS SUFFIX 0C, and it costs half the life: 5000 rotations with the click against 10000 without. (3) THE A/B LETTER IN RV09A / RV09B IS THE ROTATIONAL ANGLE (280 +/-5 deg vs 300 +/-5 deg), NOT THE TAPER. The taper is a separate A/B/C code. This is a standing trap and the row said nothing about it. (4) Body 9.8mm wide, 11.4mm across the snap-in lugs, 7.0mm board-to-shaft for every -40, shaft D6.0 0/-0.1. THREE ACROSS 50.50mm IS 34.2mm - the pot body is nowhere near binding and the 14mm knob is the constraint, which settles the open question this row carried. NOTE THE PART MAY NOT BE ALPHA: Thonk ships the Song Huei R0904N, dimensionally interchangeable (datasheets/connectors/R0904N.pdf)

This stage consumes BOTH remaining spare OPA2197 halves, so the separate A5 finding - POT-OFFSET's wiper is unbuffered, which is why its zero sits ~20deg past centre at +0.605V - needs this additional package. Both are review findings, so the package is not spare capacity being spent on a whim | 2026-09-21: SBOS737C is banked at datasheets/analog/OPA2197.pdf, 56pp. TWO CORRECTIONS THAT MATTER. (1) *** OPEN-LOOP OUTPUT IMPEDANCE IS SPECIFIED AND IT IS 375 OHM, NOT THE 75.8 OHM THIS CORPUS BACK-SOLVED. *** EC table p.8 and p.10: 'ZO Open-loop output impedance | f = 1 MHz, IO = 0 A, See Figure 26 | 375 | ohm'. Figure 26 reads ~3.26k at 0.1Hz, 482 at 10Hz, a 375 plateau from 100Hz to 300kHz, 301 at 1MHz and ~73 at 10MHz - so 75.8 ohm is roughly the 10MHz value, i.e. a defensible HF number, but it is NOT TI's specified figure and every pole derived from it moves by ~5x in the wrong direction. (2) *** THE '1 nF MAX CAPACITIVE LOAD' IS AN OPA2197 FIGURE AFTER ALL. *** It is on this part's own p.1 Features ('High Capacitive Load Drive Capability: 1 nF'), in its p.1 Description, and in section 7.3.5 p.22: 'in a unity-gain configuration, directly drives up to 1 nF of pure capacitive load'. The INA828 carries the same headline number by coincidence. The dispute filed against this figure should be closed - and per CLAUDE.md, a correct figure filed as disputed is the dangerous kind, because it stops getting re-checked. Figure 27/28 show 1 nF is a stable-but-ringing limit (~40% overshoot at unity gain), not a 30% threshold; TI recommends a 10-20 ohm isolation resistor and tabulates R_ISO for 45deg/60deg phase margin in Table 3 p.23. CONFIRMED: GBW 10MHz, SR 20V/us, Isc +-65mA, IQ 1mA/amp, ~11.9V swing on +-12V, SOIC-8 DUAL R-thJA 107.9 degC/W (the single OPA197 is 115.8 - different table). NOT-IN-DOCUMENT: the '114 dB PSRR' this corpus cites; TI specifies +-1 uV/V typ and +-3 uV/V max, i.e. 120 dB typ and 110.5 dB worst case. Conclusions unaffected, provenance was not
